reviewed_by: Claude review of the Zero Dark appearance baseline refresh
reason: 'Zero Dark preserves the appearance selector' failed on main with 'Expected an image 421px by 245px, received 421px by 246px'. Bisecting b9ba56e..c992aab (main at the time) with only this test puts the first failure at e40f47e (#349), which added the collapsed Settings > Environments group above the Appearance panel. Measured in the test at 02e831a and e40f47e: the panel is 244.516px tall in both, and its top moves from 464.078px to 463.859px. Playwright floors the top and ceils the bottom of an element screenshot clip, so the 0.22px upward shift captures 246 rows instead of 245. The panel did not grow and no appearance CSS changed, so there is nothing to fix; the baseline is regenerated for the new sub-pixel phase. The old and new images show the same heading, focus ring, four theme options, Zero Dark active state, help text and zoom note. No catalog area selected this test, so it had never run in CI since #334. New area appearance-settings selects exactly this test on desktop, its only project, and tests/test_playwright_impact.py validates the manifest. Rebased onto #365: the test still passes against this baseline on the rebased branch.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests: no ui/src change. No native tests: no Rust or Tauri change. Other Playwright projects are excluded because the test skips every project except desktop. Other screenshot tests are out of scope: only this baseline changed. No real-Core or LAN-origin runs: only a test baseline and the test catalog changed. No full suites.
